Name: Dan Utils
Author: danmw3
Description:
[color=gold][b][size=5]DanUtils - Version: 1.0[/size][/b][/color][b]
[color=orange][size=3]﻿Supports Stardew Valley 1.3 beta
Requires SMAPI[/size][/color][/b]

[size=3][b]Features(v1.0):[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Add your own chat message handler that runs when a message is sent
[*]Disable the built-in chat message handling(chat box will not be cleared, and the message will not be sent)
[*]Get direct access to the in-game ChatBox and ChatTextBox(contains the actual message text)
[*]Add custom chat commands and command handlers
[/list]

[b][size=3]Getting Started[/size]([size=3]WIP[/size]):[/b]
[size=2]Just like with any other mod-based API library, you need to reference the .dll file in your mods project.[/size]


[size=3][b]Changelog:[/b][/size]
[size=2](1.0)[/size]
[size=2] ﻿+ Added custom chat message handling.
﻿+ Implemented direct access to the in-game chat box.
﻿+ Added custom chat command support.
﻿+ Added the ability to disable standard chat message handling.[/size]
